title: GRAFT: Cross-Backbone LoRA Reuse for Continual Language and Multimodal Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18638v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In continual learning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables large language models to acquire new capabilities through lightweight adapters such as LoRA, yet the reuse of pretrained adapters is typically restricted to models sharing the same backbone. This limits the transfer of learned capabilities from language models to multimodal models. We propose GRAFT (Generalist Reuse of Adapters via Feature-space Transfer), a framework for cross-backbone LoRA reuse. GRAFT retrieves the most relevant pretrained LoRA adapter from a modality-aware library and maps it into the target backbone through a learned linear bridge between corresponding source and target feature spaces. We evaluate GRAFT on ten Super-NaturalInstructions text tasks, transferring Qwen2.5 LoRAs to Qwen2.5-VL, and five multimodal tasks, where Qwen2.5-VL LoRAs are directly reused. Compared with randomly initialized LoRA adapters, GRAFT improves performance on most evaluated

translated_title: GRAFT：面向持续语言与多模态学习的跨骨干网络LoRA复用
translated_abstract: 在持续学习中，参数高效微调使大语言模型能够通过LoRA等轻量级适配器获取新能力，然而预训练适配器的复用通常仅限于共享相同骨干网络的模型，这限制了将已学到的能力从语言模型迁移到多模态模型。我们提出GRAFT（Generalist Reuse of Adapters via Feature-space Transfer，通过特征空间迁移实现适配器的通用复用），一个跨骨干网络的LoRA复用框架。GRAFT从模态感知的适配器库中检索最相关的预训练LoRA适配器，并通过在对应的源与目标特征空间之间学习得到的线性桥接，将其映射到目标骨干网络中。我们在十个Super-NaturalInstructions文本任务上评估了GRAFT（将Qwen2.5的LoRA迁移至Qwen2.5-VL），并在五个多模态任务上直接复用Qwen2.5-VL的LoRA。与随机初始化的LoRA适配器相比，GRAFT在大多数评估任务上提升了性能。
tldr: 提出GRAFT框架，通过模态感知的适配器库检索和学习的特征空间线性桥接，实现跨骨干网络的LoRA适配器复用，使语言模型适配器可迁移至多模态模型并显著优于随机初始化。
en_tdlr: GRAFT enables cross-backbone reuse of pretrained LoRA adapters by retrieving relevant ones from a modality-aware library and mapping them into the target backbone via a learned linear feature-space bridge, outperforming random initialization on continual language and multimodal tasks.
